description: This Java source file defines the EventProcessor class, which is responsible for processing and managing event definitions within a generated service model. It handles creation of EventWrapper objects, analysis of variables involved in events, and adjustment of event codes based on XML configuration.

classes.name: EventProcessor
classes.description: Main class responsible for processing event definitions, creating EventWrapper instances, analyzing variable dependencies, and managing event and define codes.

classes.name: EventProcessor.CodeDefinition
classes.description: Inner class representing a code definition with name, value, and description.

methods.name: buildModel
methods.description: Static method that constructs and initializes an EventProcessor instance based on an ICService object, creating EventWrappers for each event in the service definition.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes variables within the event wrappers to determine dependencies, particularly focusing on event, POJO, and enum variables.

methods.name: getEventForName
methods.description: Retrieves the EventWrapper associated with a given variable name.

methods.name: getDefineCodes
methods.description: Returns the list of CodeDefinitions representing defined codes.

methods.name: getEventCodes
methods.description: Returns the list of CodeDefinitions representing event codes.
